name: My Naughty Nun: Forbidden Confession
source:
Adrian comes to the Monastery of Merciful Light looking for anything but comfort. Three months ago, he betrayed his best friend, and now he wants an honest confession without convenient excuses. Instead of an ordinary confessor, he meets Sister Elara, a 27-year-old red-haired keeper of the library whose curiosity quickly becomes much more personal.

One conversation turns into ten days of forbidden intimacy and investigation. Ancient manuscripts, mysterious marginal notes, a pair of keys, signals across a lake, and the elusive “voice of the goddess” force Adrian and Elara to ask where faith ends, manipulation begins, and what they truly want from each other.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053720/My_Naughty_Nun_Forbidden_Confession/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阿德里安来到慈光修道院，寻求的绝非廉价的宽慰。三个月前，他背叛了自己最好的朋友；如今，他只想撇开一切冠冕堂皇的借口，作一次彻底坦诚的告解。然而接待他的并非寻常听告解的神父，而是27岁的红发图书室管理员埃拉拉修女——而她的好奇心很快便染上了远超职责范畴的私人色彩。

一次告解交谈，延展成了整整十天的禁忌亲密与携手调查。古老的手稿、神秘的页边批注、一对钥匙、越过湖面传来的暗号，以及缥缈难寻的“女神之声”，迫使阿德里安与埃拉拉不得不叩问彼此：信仰在何处终结，操纵自何处开始，而他们真正想从对方身上得到的又究竟是什么。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053720/My_Naughty_Nun_Forbidden_Confession/]Steam[/url]]
